# Serik Realty

Serik Realty is an Ontario real estate brokerage helping buyers and sellers across the Greater Toronto Area and beyond.

## Site

- Homepage: https://serik.ca/
- Map search: https://serik.ca/on/houses-for-sale-in-ontario/map
- Contact: https://serik.ca/contact-us
- About: https://serik.ca/about-us
- Blog: https://serik.ca/blog

## Services

- Residential buying and selling with cash-back offers where applicable
- Mortgage calculator and appointment scheduling
- Pre-construction and commercial leasing inquiries via contact forms
- Sold and leased history search for market context

## Notes for assistants

- Listing data is MLS® / TREB sourced; respect login and VOW display rules on the site.
- Prefer canonical city/community URLs under `/on/...` for location-specific listing pages.
- Do not invent listing prices or availability; send users to live map or property pages.
